question: Why I Am An Atheist is the autobiography of which Indian freedom fighter?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhagat Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhagat Singh** is the author of the autobiography "Why I Am An Atheist".
 
• Bhagat Singh was a prominent Indian freedom fighter known for his revolutionary activities against British rule in India.
 
• He was an influential figure in the Indian independence movement and is remembered for his courage and dedication to the cause of freedom.
 
• His writings, including his autobiography, reflect his deep philosophical thoughts and his commitment to secularism and rationalism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhagat Singh** was born on 28th September 1907 and became a symbol of resistance against British colonial rule.
 
• He was involved in several revolutionary activities and was a member of the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA).
 
• He was arrested and subsequently executed on 23rd March 1931 at the age of 23.
 
• His legacy continues to inspire generations of Indians and others around the world who fight for justice and equality.
